load_scale_dict_from_json: load scale factors from a JSON file mapping scale factor names to values
load_scale_dict_from_pt: load scale factors from a PyTorch pickled dictionary file
load_scales_compat: load scale factors into a PyTorch module's ScaleFactor submodules from a file or dict
review_load_scales_compat: review the load_scales_compat function to understand how it matches scale factors to modules
refactor_load_scale_dict: refactor the _load_scale_dict function to support additional file formats beyond JSON and PT
